description.p: Soplos Kernel Installer builds your own Linux kernel with an assistant, installs ready-made kernels from Soplos, Debian, XanMod and Liquorix, and sets up Secure Boot step by step.
Soplos Kernel Installer compila tu propio kernel de Linux con un asistente, instala kernels ya preparados de Soplos, Debian, XanMod y Liquorix, y configura Secure Boot paso a paso.
Soplos Kernel Installer compile votre propre noyau Linux avec un assistant, installe des noyaux prêts à l'emploi de Soplos, Debian, XanMod et Liquorix, et configure Secure Boot pas à pas.

Soplos Kernel Installer kompiliert mit einem Assistenten deinen eigenen Linux-Kernel, installiert fertige Kernel von Soplos, Debian, XanMod und Liquorix und richtet Secure Boot Schritt für Schritt ein.
O Soplos Kernel Installer compila o seu próprio kernel Linux com um assistente, instala kernels já prontos do Soplos, Debian, XanMod e Liquorix, e configura o Secure Boot passo a passo.
Soplos Kernel Installer compila il tuo kernel Linux con un assistente, installa kernel già pronti di Soplos, Debian, XanMod e Liquorix, e configura Secure Boot passo dopo passo.
Soplos Kernel Installer compilează propriul tău kernel Linux cu un asistent, instalează kernele gata făcute de la Soplos, Debian, XanMod și Liquorix și configurează Secure Boot pas cu pas.
Soplos Kernel Installer собирает ваше собственное ядро Linux с помощью помощника, устанавливает готовые ядра Soplos, Debian, XanMod и Liquorix и настраивает Secure Boot шаг за шагом.

description.p: The level of the processor used to choose a XanMod kernel and to build a kernel is the one the window shows, read from the dynamic linker. Before, the flags of the processor could give a lower one, as on an Intel N150 in a Proxmox virtual machine.
When the compilation of a kernel fails, the message shows the first lines that say what went wrong, and not only the last ones, which are the make of the packages saying that it stopped.

The patches of a kernel are applied all or none: if one does not apply, the ones applied before come out again and no kernel with some of its patches is built. The BORE patch of firelzrd is found again in the layout its repository has now. A batch shows how long each kernel takes, and the program keeps a history of how long each kernel took to build.

Kernels with the Rust Binder (6.18 and newer) build also when the Rust of the user has no rust-src, because the Rust of Debian is used. The batch page is in four boxes, a batch is followed in the Build page too, and the output of a build goes down to its last line without a second scroll. Added the panel of what a build costs the computer (time, CPU, memory, disk and temperature), the question about the folder of the builds when a build is cancelled, and Ctrl+Tab to change page.

On a computer with an NVIDIA graphics card, the package installs a kernel hook that downloads the latest patches of the nvidia-patches project and applies them to the NVIDIA driver sources before DKMS builds the module, so the kernels that arrive from a terminal build it too.

Installing or updating a kernel of Soplos from the repository, and installing or updating this package, leaves the sources of the NVIDIA driver patched, as the 2.x program did, so the kernels that arrive later from a terminal build the module. Screenshots of the Build, Kernels, Installed and Secure Boot pages.
First beta of the rewrite of Soplos Kernel Installer, from Python 3 and GTK3 to Tauri 2 with a Rust backend and a Svelte frontend. It has not yet been tested with a complete build on real hardware.
First alpha: the pages Kernels, Installed and Secure Boot, and the first skeleton of the assistant to build a kernel.
